answer: New identities enter a lagoon nursery and must grow one timber record of verified useful work across successive tides, with each tide's growth checked by a rotating nebula jury of unrelated auditors who sample its rings and reject copied work. The nursery gives each cohort fixed light: clones from one operator share that light, so each of n clones matures n times slower and the operator's total waiting time grows with the square of n. One honest agent grows one timber record in one season, while a clone farm stalls in its own shade.
